market: Europe Urea-Formaldehyde and Melamine-Formaldehyde Adhesives Market
market_definition: The urea- and melamine-formaldehyde adhesives market comprises amino-resin thermosetting adhesives used chiefly to bond wood-based panels. It measures sales of liquid and powder resin adhesives and their formaldehyde-reduced variants. BY RESIN TYPE: Urea-Formaldehyde (UF), Melamine-Formaldehyde (MF), Melamine-Urea-Formaldehyde (MUF). BY EMISSION CLASS: Standard Emission, Low-Emission (E1), Ultra-Low / No-Added-Formaldehyde. BY FORM: Liquid, Powder. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Particleboard, Medium-Density Fibreboard (MDF), Plywood, Furniture & Cabinetry, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Phenolic adhesives; PVAc and bio-based wood adhesives; amino resins used in coatings, moulding compounds or laminates. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
